function.arguments: {"finding": "The crude response rate difference between female and male patients in the treatment arm is -2.9% (F - M), meaning women have a *lower* response rate than men. This contradicts the premise that 'female patients respond better'. Moreover, the treatment arm is strongly confounded by baseline severity: women are more likely to have mild or moderate severity, while men are more likely to have severe disease. Since severity is a strong predictor of response (response rates drop from ~97% in mild to ~30% in severe), the lower response in women is likely due to their better baseline condition, not worse treatment effect. Thus, the observed difference is not evidence of worse response in women, but a consequence of confounding.", "implication": "The premise 'female patients respond better' is false. function.name: note_finding
